The current ultimate estimated losses for Helene and Milton are gross/net $22.0m and gross/net $25.8m respectively.

From 7th January 2025 to 31st January 2025, a series of wildfires devastated the Los Angeles metropolitan area, exacerbated by drought conditions, low humidity and hurricane-force Santa Ana winds. Whilst the loss is still in the early stages of being quantified, it is certain there will be a material impact to Syndicate 6103, particularly affecting the 2024 year of account. Based on a market loss of between $30-50bn, the current anticipated net impact range for the Syndicate will be in region of $30-50m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 7.361m, representing 20.99% of its opening gross reserves. This was primarily driven by a favourable development on the 2022 year of account as calculated from the claims development triangle, and a significant release due to the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the 2021 year of account into Syndicate 2791. The overall movement indicates favourable claims development for prior underwriting years. The syndicate's business is exclusively US property catastrophe reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development figure is calculated from the claims development triangle for 2022 YOA and the RITC for 2021 YOA. The narrative on page 12 provides a net prior year movement figure of GBP 5.8m, which is not used for the gross amount.
